// exclude: Tests are typechecked by tsconfig.test.json, the only config that sees @types/node. Keeping them out here is what keeps this narrow `types` list meaningful: app code is still compiled without Node globals, so a stray `process.env` in a component fails typecheck instead of exploding in the browser. `src/test` stays IN — setup.ts loads the jest-dom matcher augmentations that the test config inherits, and dropping it here breaks unrelated inference.
